description: Binding bound-type selection: an explicit boundType disambiguates an implementation that has two unrelated super types and is exposed as a single binding; the same disambiguation also works for a multibinding element declared in a deeply nested package.

sources:
package com.bind

import software.amazon.lastmile.kotlin.inject.anvil.ContributesBinding
import me.tatarka.inject.annotations.Inject

interface Repository
interface Cache

@Inject
@ContributesBinding(Unit::class, boundType = Repository::class)
class CombinedImpl : Repository, Cache

cases.expected_output:
status=compiled
contribution origin=com.bind.CombinedImpl
provides from=com.bind.CombinedImpl to=com.bind.Repository kind=single

sources:
package com.plugins.audio

import software.amazon.lastmile.kotlin.inject.anvil.ContributesBinding
import me.tatarka.inject.annotations.Inject

interface Plugin
interface AudioPlugin : Plugin

@Inject
@ContributesBinding(Unit::class, boundType = Plugin::class, multibinding = true)
class Mp3Plugin : AudioPlugin

cases.expected_output:
status=compiled
contribution origin=com.plugins.audio.Mp3Plugin
provides from=com.plugins.audio.Mp3Plugin to=com.plugins.audio.Plugin kind=multi
